heading_path: 32  Registrar to decide on disputed classification of goods etc.
text: If a question arises as to the class in which goods or services are comprised: (a) that question is to be decided by the Registrar; and (b) the decision of the Registrar is not subject to appeal and may not be called into question in an appeal or other proceedings under this Act.
title: Registrar to decide on disputed classification of goods etc.
